about_the_game:
🏈 Football Temptations is an adult visual novel with a sports theme, blending the drama of professional football with romance, temptation, and life-changing choices.

You play as James, a young American football player with sky-high potential. This spring, his dream began to take shape: drafted by the Philadelphia Hawks and signed to a rookie contract. Against the odds, he earned a spot on the final 53-man roster.

But this is just the beginning. To stay on the field—and maybe lead his team all the way to the Bowl—James will have to prove himself fast. A few bad games, and he could be cut. One great season, and he could become a star.

Off the field, the pressure doesn’t ease up. Fame brings attention, especially from women. But temptation can be a dangerous distraction—especially without a steady relationship to keep him grounded. Your challenge is to balance personal life and professional ambition.

Every decision counts. How you answer press conferences and interact with teammates, fans, and women will directly impact your performance in each game.

Victory conditions: By the end of the season, your goal is to win the Bowl and have a girlfriend by your side. Achieving only one of these counts as a half-victory, meaning sometimes you’ll need to sacrifice a few games to enrich your personal life. Even a championship can feel empty without someone to share it with.

✨ FEATURES

  • Branched story with meaningful choices — your answers and actions lead to different paths and endings

  • Full American football season — from regular games to playoffs

  • Sport-sim elements — press conferences, training, social media, and fan reactions

  • Many female characters to meet and romance

  • Many conflict situations with women, fans, teammates and etc

  • Variety of sex scenes with different kinks and fetishes

  • Multiple endings — you can win the Bowl or fail to reach the playoffs, you can end up with a different girlfriend depending on your choices

  • Voiced commentary during games

  • Beautiful renders and cinematic storytelling

  • Diverse events and locations — casinos, bars, restaurants, and more

WISHLIST NOW!
